root_cause: Live inventory represented mounts as tuples; JSON stage receipts restored them as lists. Direct equality rejected an unchanged service.
correction: Keep mount rows JSON-stable at inventory creation. Resource, environment, image, container identity and mount drift guards remain enforced.
schema_run_correction: A profiled release uses its already source-verified app image for the isolated schema command. It does not request an absent unprofiled image or replace the running API.
regression_cases: Real inventory structure survives persisted stage receipt and detects changed mount permissions
Isolated schema command selects a verified profile and rejects unverified images
